name: Mug Cake
steps: Choose 4 microwave-safe mugs of at least 250 ml capacity; mix flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
Whisk in milk, oil and vanilla until no dry flour remains; fold in chopped chocolate.
Divide batter equally among the mugs, leaving ample room to rise; wipe splashes from the rims.
Microwave each mug separately at 800 W for 70–90 seconds until just set; rest for 2 minutes before eating.
tips: Microwave power varies; add short bursts only if the centre is still wet.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
